address_model.note: For the audited late/code fixups, reconstructed object1 offset = encoded fixup source/target offset - 0x2AA8. The mapping is cross-calibrated against the V115 WORLD opcode 0x28 sound handler.

pacing.readme_runtime_observation: The original demo documentation states that the high-resolution mode moves slowest and the low-resolution mode moves fastest, consistent with gameplay speed being coupled to rendering/update throughput rather than a single fixed gameplay Hz.
pacing.production_policy: Preserve one integer source-frame advance per equivalent legacy scene-update pass. Do not label any chosen modern wall-clock pacing value as source-exact without a reference pacing profile or original-runtime measurement.

supersedes.v196_limitation: V196 correctly held fixed Hz but its exact-target relocation search did not account for the audited 0x2AA8 late fixup bias. V197 proves the missing registered callback edge while retaining the wall-clock pacing HOLD.
